overall_notes: This paper is primarily a mechanistic interpretability study focusing on how multilingual language models develop cross-lingual representations during pre-training. While it does involve text generation (specifically controlled generation via neuron manipulation), the main contribution is analytical rather than NLG evaluation. The paper uses automatic language detection as its only evaluation metric for generated outputs, with no human or LLM-based evaluation.
